categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: intelligent sensing and automotive lighting, accounting for 54% and 42% of revenue respectively. It specializes in LED light sources and sensing components, including visible, infrared, and ultraviolet LEDs, as well as integrated optoelectronic sensor modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced LED packaging technologies, including high-precision manufacturing, IC circuit integration, and testing. It develops smart LED products with integrated driver ICs, multi-signal transmission components, and optical sensing technologies such as Time of Flight (ToF) sensors and optical tracking sensors. The production includes surface mount technology and vertical packaging integration, with a strong emphasis on miniaturization and high integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers requiring smart cabin lighting and exterior automotive lighting, as well as consumer electronics sectors such as laptops, gaming devices, smart home products, and wearable devices. The company also serves industrial automation, security monitoring, and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are concentrated mainly in Asia, particularly Greater China, with growing efforts to expand into overseas markets including Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. Production facilities are located in Shenzhen, Kunshan, and Jiangsu (Nantong) in China, with corporate headquarters in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the LED and optoelectronic supply chain, focusing on LED packaging and module assembly. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of LED chips and ICs and supplies downstream customers in automotive and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-end automotive smart LED lighting and intelligent sensing modules, integrating AI algorithms for advanced color control and system optimization. The company is investing in silicon photonics and expanding its capabilities in semiconductor packaging and integrated modules. It emphasizes innovation in miniaturized, multi-functional smart LEDs and high-precision optical sensors for emerging applications like autonomous driving and smart cabins.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of LED light sources, sensing components, and integrated modules. The company also benefits from licensing and technology development partnerships, with a focus on supplying high-value, customized solutions to automotive and consumer electronics manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international LED and optoelectronic component manufacturers, particularly in the automotive lighting and sensing markets. It positions itself as a technology leader in niche markets by offering advanced integrated packaging and smart LED solutions, leveraging cost advantages and comprehensive system integration capabilities to differentiate from larger competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$860 million, a slight decrease of 2.4% from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$166.9 million, showing a 2.6% increase. Total assets grew by 31% to NT$2.56 billion, supported by capital investments including a new production facility in Nantong. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering technologically advanced, high-quality LED and sensing products with superior integration and miniaturization. Its unique value lies in combining smart LED lighting with AI-driven control algorithms and multi-signal transmission components, enabling cost-effective, high-performance solutions tailored for intelligent automotive cabins and consumer electronics. The vertical integration from component design to module assembly enhances customer value through faster time-to-market and system-level innovation.
